# SabTools.in

> SabTools.in is a free online tools platform for India offering 450+ calculators, converters, PDF tools, image editors, and AI writing utilities across 38 categories. Every tool runs client-side in the browser with zero data collection, requires no signup, and supports Indian formats (₹, lakhs/crores, GST slabs, FY 2025-26 tax rules). 424+ tools are also available in Hindi.

SabTools.in was founded in 2025 by Rakesh Seervi. It is a free, privacy-first alternative to ad-heavy, signup-gated calculator websites. Tools follow Indian standards from the RBI, Income Tax Department, GST Council, and ICMR. No data ever leaves the user's device.

## About
- [About SabTools.in](https://sabtools.in/about): What SabTools is, who built it, and why — 450+ free tools, privacy-first, built for India.

## Popular Finance & Tax Calculators
- [GST Calculator](https://sabtools.in/tools/gst-calculator): Calculate GST at 5%, 12%, 18%, 28% — inclusive and exclusive, with CGST/SGST/IGST split.
- [EMI Calculator](https://sabtools.in/tools/emi-calculator): Home, car, and personal loan EMI using the standard reducing-balance formula matching Indian banks.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://sabtools.in/tools/income-tax-calculator): Income tax for FY 2025-26 under old and new regime, with slab-wise breakdown, cess, and 87A rebate.
- [SIP Calculator](https://sabtools.in/tools/sip-calculator): Mutual fund SIP returns with optional step-up and goal planning.
- [FD Calculator](https://sabtools.in/tools/fd-calculator): Fixed deposit maturity and interest with quarterly compounding.
- [PPF Calculator](https://sabtools.in/tools/ppf-calculator): Public Provident Fund maturity over a 15-year horizon.
- [HRA Exemption Calculator](https://sabtools.in/tools/hra-calculator): HRA exemption under Section 10(13A) — minimum of actual HRA, rent minus 10% basic, and 50%/40% basic.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://sabtools.in/tools/compound-interest-calculator): Compound interest with monthly, quarterly, or yearly compounding.
- [Lakh & Crore Converter](https://sabtools.in/tools/lakh-crore-converter): Convert lakh & crore to million, billion & arab. 1 lakh crore = 1 trillion = 1,000 billion; 1 crore = 10 million.

## Popular Utility & Health Tools
- [BMI Calculator](https://sabtools.in/tools/bmi-calculator): Body Mass Index with both WHO and ICMR (South Asian) categories.
- [Compress PDF](https://sabtools.in/tools/compress-pdf): Compress PDF files to a target size (e.g. 100KB) for Indian government and exam uploads — runs entirely in the browser.
- [Age Calculator](https://sabtools.in/tools/age-calculator): Exact age in years, months, and days.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://sabtools.in/tools/percentage-calculator): Percentage increase, decrease, and of-value calculations.

## Tool Categories
- [Finance Calculators](https://sabtools.in/category/finance): EMI, SIP, FD, RD, PPF, loan and investment calculators.
- [Tax & Salary](https://sabtools.in/category/tax): Income tax, HRA, TDS, EPF, NPS, and salary calculators for India.
- [PDF Tools](https://sabtools.in/category/pdf): Compress, merge, split, and convert PDF files.
- [Image Tools](https://sabtools.in/category/image): Compress, resize, crop, and convert JPG, PNG, WebP images.
- [Health & Fitness](https://sabtools.in/category/health): BMI, BMR, calorie, and pregnancy calculators using ICMR/WHO standards.
- [Developer Tools](https://sabtools.in/category/developer): JSON formatter, Base64, hash generator, regex tester.
- [AI Writing Tools](https://sabtools.in/category/ai): Paragraph rewriter, email writer, story and bio generators.
- [Education](https://sabtools.in/category/education): GPA, CGPA, grade calculators and study tools.
- [Exam & Competitive](https://sabtools.in/category/exam): NEET, JEE, GATE, CAT score predictors and board percentage tools.
- [Real Estate](https://sabtools.in/category/realestate): Stamp duty, plot area, paint, tile, and cement calculators.
- [Business](https://sabtools.in/category/business): GST invoice, profit/loss, ROI, and break-even calculators.
- [Sports & Cricket](https://sabtools.in/category/sports): IPL fantasy points, run rate, NRR, and cricket calculators.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2025, by Rakesh Seervi
- Tools: 450+ across 38 categories
- Hindi tools: 424+
- Cost: 100% free, no signup, no ads on tools
- Privacy: all calculations run client-side; no user data is collected or uploaded
- Built for: Indian users (₹ currency, lakhs/crores, GST slabs, FY 2025-26 tax rules, RBI/ICMR standards)
